title: Phase A5 package export and wildcard subpath parity

supportingSourceFiles.coverage: Every pinned application directory is exercised through the ./applications/* wildcard consumer test.

sourceOracles.coverage: Pinned package export keys, subpath availability and public application barrel behavior.

independentValidation.method: Strict typed static imports, source-pinned runtime imports, exact package-key comparison, exact subpath export-name comparison, and wildcard directory/export comparison.
independentValidation.fixture: All 14 declared package keys and every pinned application barrel resolved from the self-referencing migration-workspace package.

tolerances.serializedParity: exact source-defined serializable values, with the two documented pre-existing target-only normative-reference compatibility entries excluded from the source projection
tolerances.numericParity: exact for serializable catalog and schema values
tolerances.publicStrings: exact entrypoint keys, export names, identifiers and source ordering
tolerances.errors: unresolvable entrypoints and missing wildcard barrels fail the consumer tests

parityDifferences: The package identity remains the private 0.0.0 migration workspace; no publish, rename, tag or cutover is introduced.
The inventory represents ./applications/* through the target applications barrel for name accounting; the consumer test additionally resolves every concrete wildcard directory.

The target retains the already-documented serviceModularRatio and cosenzaCircularShear normative-reference compatibility entries; the subpath test compares the complete source-defined projection without silently removing or altering them at runtime.

Approved architecture decision: AXIAL_PILE_CAPACITY_REFERENCE, AXIAL_PILE_CAPACITY_RESULT_SCHEMA_VERSION and AxialPileCapacityAnalysis remain available from the root and norms surfaces but are not re-exported through domain/geotechnics, because doing so would make domain import norms. A future compatibility decision may relocate or otherwise expose these three source subpath names without reversing the dependency direction.
engineeringFunctionality: Restored all 14 pinned package entrypoints, direct subpath exports, wildcard application barrels and declaration-level self-package consumers without exposing private source paths.
